newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-RMC eyes Eastern Europe for buys.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-RMC eyes Eastern Europe for buys.

text.p: UK building materials giant RMC Group Plc said on Thursday it was looking for partnerships and bolt-on acquisitions in Eastern Europe.

David Jenkins, finance director, said in an interview the group was willing to raise its gearing to 50 percent from 30 percent if the right deal came along, bearing in mind its strong financial position. "There is plenty of scope for gearing up. I wouldn't think that 50 percent was too dangerous," he said.
RMC is interested in expansion in Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovenia in particular.

Commenting on the decision to change its accounting policy, the finance chief said RMC was, "the second to last in the sector to do it," adding that it had been under consideration for some time in light of the strength of sterling against the mark and dollar.

The change from using end-of-year exchange rates to a year average would give a truer reflection of underlying trading, he said, as the impact was more due to exchange rate translations than the impact on sales from the stronger pound.

Turning to current trading, he said Germany was sure to show some improvement in profits this year as recent restructuring delivered its benefits. The UK has also benefited from an upturn in the domestic housing and commercial marekts.
In the U.S., he said "Conditions are very bouyant in Florida and South Carolina and the recovery in northern California continues."
